settings.heading: A boutique built on tradition
settings.text:
Emmy's Closet began in 2016 with a simple belief — that childhood deserves clothing made to last. We hand-select every piece from the heritage labels parents have trusted for generations, so the smocked dresses and classic Jon Jons your little ones wear today become the keepsakes you'll pass down tomorrow.

Family-owned, endlessly detail-obsessed, and here for every milestone — from coming-home outfits to first-day portraits.
